reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the concept of cryogenic, deformation-driven LCO evolution (P12, P24) with heterogeneous lattice strain strengthening (P10) and SRO rejuvenation (P23, P46), and transfers this combined mechanism to the high-strain-rate, ambient-temperature regime, which none of the passages propose. The specific prediction of transient, reversible SRO formation under dynamic loading as the primary strengthening mechanism is a new integration not stated in the literature.
